items.title: Gambia Crowned WAFU Zone A U-17 Champions After Dramatic Shootout Win Over Senegal
items.summary: By Staff Writer The Gambia’s under-17 national team were crowned WAFU Zone A champions on Sunday after defeating hosts Senegal 5-4 in a dramatic penalty shootout, with goalkeeper Vanou Gomez delivering two crucial saves in a tense final in Dakar. The match ended goalless after...
items.author: Staff Writer
